newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield at Indian 14-day t-bill at 4.96 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield at Indian 14-day t-bill at 4.96 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it maintained a cut-off rate of 99.81 rupees at an auction of 14-day treasury bills on Thursday.
Dealers said the yield was unchanged at 4.96 percent.
RBI said it received four competitive bids for 30 billion rupees, along with one non-competitive bid amounting to 1.25 billion rupees. It accepted all the bids.
There was no devolvement. The face value of bills issued was 31.25 billion rupees. The weighted average cut-off worked out to 99.81 rupees.
